Package io.github.janglada.orkit.jobshop

Interface JobShopGoal

All Known Implementing Classes:
JobShopGoal.MinimizeMakespan, JobShopGoal.MinimizeMakespanAndTardiness, JobShopGoal.MinimizeTardiness, JobShopGoal.MinimizeWeightedCompletionTime
public sealed interface JobShopGoal permits JobShopGoal.MinimizeMakespan, JobShopGoal.MinimizeTardiness, JobShopGoal.MinimizeMakespanAndTardiness, JobShopGoal.MinimizeWeightedCompletionTime
Objective for a job-shop problem. Create instances via Goals.

Hard release dates / deadlines (set per operation via OperationConfig.releaseAt(long) / OperationConfig.deadlineAt(long)) are enforced as constraints regardless of the selected goal. The goal only selects the objective expression; soft due dates (OperationConfig.dueBy(long)) take effect under a goal that includes tardiness. Per-job weights multiply that job's tardiness and completion-time terms.

    JobShopGoal.MinimizeWeightedCompletionTime
    Minimize sum(jobWeight * completionTime) over all jobs, where completion is the end of the last operation.
